Day 9 - Water parameters and maintenance

April 30 2026

Snipped some long Pearlweed stems and replanted. Nitrates seemed to be a little high but they went down over the course of the day. The plants are doing their job. Trying GH and KH test kit

GH: 9/10 161.1/179ppm KH: 4/5 71.6/89.5ppm It’s a bit high. pH: 7.5

Tap GH: 9 161.1 KH: 5 89.5

Brita: GH: 6 107.4 KH: 3 53.7

Topped up with some drinking water! Noticing the plants fighting and growing.
